review.assessment: The change replaces the original single-pipe `tr | sort | uniq -c` with a seven-stage pipeline that correctly handles arbitrary whitespace splitting, case-insensitivity via lowercasing, empty-line filtering, and dual-key sorting (count descending, word ascending).
